name: EZ Bar Reverse-Grip Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms flat against the pad and grip an EZ bar using an overhand palms-down grip.
Start with your arms nearly straight down the pad and your wrists aligned in a neutral position.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders while keeping the backs of your hands facing upward and your elbows anchored.
Lower the EZ bar slowly back down the pad without letting your wrists collapse.
tips: Keep your elbows and upper arms pressed against the pad throughout the movement.
Use a lighter weight than a standard preacher curl to maintain crisp forearm control.
